verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents several background automations it runs itself: managed LLM-as-a-judge evaluators that automatically score sampled live production traces, scheduled blob-storage exports, and threshold alerts that fire to Slack, GitHub Actions, or webhooks. These are fixed, purpose-built automations rather than a general facility for users to define their own autonomous workflows. Missing for 10: user-definable general-purpose automation/workflow builder, documented configuration depth for schedules and triggers, independent or hands-on corroboration of these background jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automatically score live production traces LLM-as-a-Judge
Production hallucination detection runs an LLM-as-a-judge evaluator on a sample of live traffic
Export large volumes on a schedule
Get notified over Slack, GitHub Actions, or Webhooks when a metric crosses a threshold with alerts
